pages.text: $(thing)G$(): enable or disable the form.$(br)$(thing)H$(): skill tree menu.$(br)$(thing)R$(): ability mode. The hotbar replaces the ability panel.$(br)$(thing)T$() (hold): wheel of passive abilities.
pages.title: Controls

pages.text: In $(thing)R$() mode, abilities from the «Active» panel are triggered by numbers $(thing)1-9$(), and the three main abilities are triggered by hotkeys $(thing)V$(), $(thing)B$(), $(thing)N$().$(br2)All keys can be changed in the control settings.
In the skill tree menu, there are buttons for «Passive», «Active», and «Primary» abilities. There, you can change the order of abilities, remove them from the panel, and put them back.
